offence_note: Possession for trafficking marihuana, unregistered firearm, production of marihuana

offence_note: Possession of cocaine for the purpose of trafficking
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal, allow the appeal and reduce the sentence of 14 months incarceration to eight months.

offence_note: Break and enter to commit assault with a weapon
sentence_quote: I would reduce the sentence to 20 months' imprisonment, less time served.
note: Banishment term removed from three-year probation; credit is enhanced credit of 495 days.

sentence_quote: The sentence imposed was fit. The trial judge considered and balanced the mitigating and aggravating features of this case.
note: Sentence appeal dismissed; sentence terms not stated in endorsement.

offence_note: Criminal negligence causing death of hang gliding passenger
sentence_quote: For the offence of criminal negligence causing death, I sentence you to a term of imprisonment of five months in addition to the ten days that you have spent in custody on this matter.
note: Joint submission accepted; probation bars hang gliding.

offence_note: Assault causing bodily harm on intimate partner

note: Section 110 prohibition limited to crossbow and restricted weapons, not hunting firearms.

sentence_quote: In our view, the trial judge did not err in principle in refusing to impose a conditional sentence.
